text: Assumption: The division into SynchronizedPoolResource and UnsynchronizedPoolResource aims to enable thread-local allocations without synchronization overhead in deterministic execution contexts, while shared resources are thread-safe protected — is this correct?

assumption: The division into SynchronizedPoolResource and UnsynchronizedPoolResource aims to enable thread-local allocations without synchronization overhead in deterministic execution contexts, while shared resources are thread-safe protected.
rationale: Both types implement the same NVI interface of MemoryResource, but differ in their internal synchronization according to SWS_CORE_00030 and SWS_CORE_00046.
